statements.text:
Sourcing components for the U.S.’s electric grid from foreign entities of concern poses unacceptable vulnerabilities to our infrastructure and millions of Americans. 

I joined my @RepublicanStudy colleagues in urging Secretary Lutnick to address this national security risk and support domestic and allied production. 

Demand for power is increasing at a historic rate due to AI advancements and the construction of new data centers. We must take steps now to ensure the security and resilience of our grid.
